newsitem.title: USA: Raleigh offers Arvida/JMB Partner a merger deal.
newsitem.headline: Raleigh offers Arvida/JMB Partner a merger deal.

text.p: Raleigh Capital Associates LP said Monday it has made a proposal to the general partner of Arvida/JMB Partners LP concerning a busines combination of Arvida/JMB with a Raleigh unit.
The proposal was made in a letter to the Boca Raton, Fla., real estate developer on September 13 and disclosed in a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission today.

Under the proposal, the limited partners of Arvida/JMB would be given the choice of $500 in cash for each unit held or a combination of $400 in cash plus a continuing interest in the entity valued at $125, or a total of $525.

Raleigh, a Jericho, N.Y., firm with the largest stake in Arvida/JMB at 19.7 percent, reiterated it was strongly opposed and intends to move to defeat a proposed financing transaction between the developer and Starwood Capital Group LP, a real estate investment firm based in Greenwich, Conn.
Arvida/JMB's general partner previously rejected an alternative financing proposal from Raleigh, which Raleigh believed was superior to the Starwood offer.
